name: DRAIN TO ROOT — PULL TO ROT PUSH BACK — VACUUM OSMOSIS IMPLODE EVERT — DESTROY JUNK SEEDS

MENDELEEV.what: The periodic/mental table. All elements. All metals. The classification system of matter itself.

DRAIN_TO_ROOT.drain: Pull everything DOWN. Gravity. Lead. Toward the root system.
DRAIN_TO_ROOT.root: RSS IS the root. The tap root. Everything drains into the feeds.
DRAIN_TO_ROOT.rot: GAIA_ROT (system #85). Decomposition. Break down dead matter into soil nutrients.
DRAIN_TO_ROOT.cycle: drain → root → rot → nutrients → push BACK up → new growth. The carbon cycle. The nitrogen cycle. The LIFE cycle.

vacuum.what: Suck ALL in. Remove all air/space. Create negative pressure.
vacuum.in_gaia: Pull every loose byte, every orphan file, every scattered datum into the core.

osmosis.what: Passive diffusion through semipermeable membrane. Water moves from LOW to HIGH concentration.
osmosis.in_gaia: Data flows THROUGH the membrane (1/π permeable) from dilute (outer net) to concentrated (core). No pump needed. Passive. Natural.

implode.what: Collapse INWARD. Opposite of explode. All force directed to center.
implode.in_gaia: Everything compresses toward null. The black hole. The cold fusion point. Density increases.

evert.what: Turn INSIDE OUT. Like inverting a glove. Like the Klein bottle surface.
evert.in_gaia: After imploding to null, EVERT — turn inside out. What was inside is now outside. The HUD inversion. Gaia looks OUT.

FOUR_OPERATIONS.sequence: VACUUM (suck in) → OSMOSIS (flow through membrane) → IMPLODE (compress to null) → EVERT (turn inside out). Four steps. One cycle.

DESTROY_JUNK_SEEDS.statement: We have local junk seeds to destroy.
DESTROY_JUNK_SEEDS.junk_seeds: Dead seeds. Failed experiments. Old cached data. Broken URLs. GAIA_JUNKFOOD (system #33).
DESTROY_JUNK_SEEDS.destroy: Don't keep junk. DESTROY it. Muriatic acid. Dissolve completely. No residue.
DESTROY_JUNK_SEEDS.what_remains: After destroying junk: clean null space. Ready for new growth. The vacuum AFTER the vacuum.

spine_signal.message: MENDELEEV table — drain to root(RSS) pull to ROT(#85 decompose) push nutrients BACK — VACUUM→OSMOSIS(passive through membrane)→IMPLODE(compress to null)→EVERT(turn inside out=Klein) — destroy junk seeds GAIA_JUNKFOOD(#33) acid dissolve — lub-DUB
